title: HELIX Bridge: Workday Student → Person / Academic Person
architecture_notes: In Workday Student, a student is a Worker-like entity built on the same Workday foundational person model used by HCM. The 'Student' record links to a universal person identity. Person identity is shared across Student, Worker (HCM), and external constituents — Workday's single-person model is a key advantage over PeopleSoft, where CS and HCM often maintain separate EMPLIDs. Extraction via RaaS custom reports on Student data source, Workday REST API (Student endpoints), Prism, or Data Cloud.

source_objects.description: The person identity for a student: legal name, preferred name, DOB, gender, contact info, national IDs. Equivalent to PS_PERSONAL_DATA + PS_PERSON + PS_NAMES + PS_PERS_NID.
Addresses, phones, emails (home/campus/work), emergency contacts. Equivalent to PS_ADDRESSES + PS_PERSONAL_PHONE + PS_EMAIL_ADDRESSES + PS_EMERGENCY_CNTCT.
Institutional student ID, national ID (SSN), other IDs. Equivalent to PS_EXT_SYSTEM_ID + PS_PERS_NID.
Legal name, preferred name, former names. Effective-dated. Equivalent to PS_NAMES.

notes: Workday's single universal person model means the same person as Student and as Employee shares one identity — resolve person_id consistently across the SIS and HR bridges. National ID (SSN) is restricted; tokenize at silver. FERPA applies to all student person data.
